name: magrabi-vendor-hub
description: MAGRABi Vendor Hub: vendor onboarding across seven markets. AI reads, rules check, registries confirm, a person decides.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gold,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
